en: A printed color illustration of a neoclassical building with a strong row of tall columns and many rectangular windows, seen from an oblique street view. A green street lamp hangs on an ornate bracket in the foreground, and a few pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. The reverse side is a divided-back postcard with printed Hungarian and German text and no handwriting.
